scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
Finally, it's time...
Hey, what's your name?
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
终于到了时候...
嘿，你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
{0}?
Got it. I'll remember your name.
A master told me that you are a person with ability.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
{0}？
明白了。我会记住你的名字。
师父告诉我，你是一个有才能的人。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
What? You are a distrustful person.
Hmm, whatever.
I heard that you are a person with ability.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
什么？你是个多疑的人。
嗯，算了。
我听说你是一个有才能的人。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
My duty is delivering a guild message to a capable assassin.
I think that you are suitable to perform the guild's duty.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
我的职责是将公会的消息传达给有能力的刺客。
我认为你适合执行公会的任务。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
So, would you perform this duty for us?
Of course, I'm going to offer a reward for completing your task.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
那么，你愿意为我们执行这个任务吗？
当然，完成任务后我会提供奖励。

scripts.text: What is the request?
scripts.translation: 有什么要求？

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
It's unclear.
I told you. It's a special task.
The only thing I know is the condition to bring a person with the master's ability.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
不清楚。
我告诉过你，这是一个特殊任务。
我只知道需要找一个拥有师父般能力的人。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
First, one who has patience.
Second, one who is quiet.
Third, one who is focused.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
第一，要有耐心。
第二，要安静。
第三，要专注。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
What do you think about what I told you?
This task means that it needs a person who can perform a task irrespective of their own will.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
你觉得我说的怎么样？
这个任务意味着需要一个能不顾个人意愿去执行任务的人。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
It's necessary to keep this request secret.
But it's also your duty not to tell anyone.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
必须对这个请求保密。
但这也是你的职责，不要告诉任何人。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
This is all your choice.
Will you help us with this request?
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
这完全是你的选择。
你愿意帮助我们完成这个请求吗？

scripts.text: I'll do it.
scripts.translation: 我会做的。

scripts.text: Give me time to think.
scripts.translation: 让我考虑一下

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
Ok, to Veins.
I'll contact them.
It's your first duty to go to Veins.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
好的，去伯仁斯。
我会联系他们。
你的第一个任务是去伯仁斯。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
You should be able to find it easily.
Go now.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
你应该能很容易找到那里。
现在去吧。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
Got it.
But don't think about it for too long.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
明白了。
但别想太久。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
Hmm, you are my peer.
I'm Ahcart. I'm from Veins.
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
嗯，你是我的同行。
我是阿卡特，来自伯仁斯。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
Of course, a chapter of the assassin guild is not only in Morocc. If you have a chance to go there, visit there.
I think you might go there.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
当然，刺客公会的一个分部不仅仅在莫洛可。如果有机会去那里，就去拜访一下。
我想你可能会去那里。

scripts.text:
[A man of a sharp impression]
....
What the...?
You are not an assassin.
scripts.translation:
[目光锐利的男子]
....
这...？
你不是刺客。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
If you become stronger and more skillful, then the assassin's guild will give you a special task.
Go for it.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
如果你变得更强、更熟练，刺客公会就会给你一个特殊任务。
加油吧。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
Have you thought about it more?
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
你想好了吗？

scripts.text: I'll do it.
scripts.translation: 我会做的。

scripts.text: I'm not ready.
scripts.translation: 我还没准备好

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
Ok, to Veins.
I'll contact them.
It's your first duty to go to Veins.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
好的，去伯仁斯。
我会联系他们。
你的第一个任务是去伯仁斯。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
You should be able to find it easily.
Go now.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
你应该能很容易找到那里。
现在去吧。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
You are too cautious.
I get the sense that you don't want to work for us.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
你太谨慎了。
我感觉你并不想为我们工作。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
Go to Veins and find a chapter.
You can hear more details from there.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
去伯仁斯，找到一个分部。
在那里你可以听到更详细的情报。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
Good luck to you.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
祝你好运。

而且，玛德勒告诉我那是个男人，克雷夫却说是个女孩。
我很困惑。

scripts.text:
{0}
Let me rethink this.
scripts.translation:
{0}
让我再想想。

scripts.text:
{0}
Yeah, adventurers often visit so it can't be a proper reason.
scripts.translation:
{0}
是啊，冒险者经常来访，这不能算是一个合理的理由。

scripts.text:
{0}
The thing Trovan suspected is that his residence is unclear. But he shows up often and buys supplies regularly.
scripts.translation:
{0}
特罗万怀疑的是他的居住地不明。但他经常露面，而且定期购买补给品。

scripts.text: Madelle witnessed 2...
scripts.translation: 玛德勒看到了2个人...

scripts.text: There are more than 2...
scripts.translation: 不止2个人...

scripts.text: It could be a helper.
scripts.translation: 可能是助手。

scripts.text:
{0}
Yeah. There could be one more helper.
She sent a person to buy the stuff instead of herself.
Or it could be a peer Madelle can't see.
scripts.translation:
{0}
是啊。可能还有一个助手。
她派了个人来买东西，而不是自己来。
或者那是玛德勒看不到的同伴。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Oh~ you're good-looking!
So, what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
哦~你长得真好看！
那么，你想要什么？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Hmm, you're a girl.
Ok pick up whatever you want.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
嗯，你是女孩。
好吧，随便拿你想要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
The room in the corner. Feel free to enter it because no one enters that room anyway.
Or do you need something?
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
角落里的房间。反正没人进那个房间，你可以随意进去。
或者你需要什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Oh~! good for me.
Who is she?
You told her that we'll protect her?
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
哦~！真是帮了我的忙。
她是谁？
你告诉她我们会保护她吗？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
She is in a room.
The one in front of master's room.
Can you find it?
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
她在房间里。
就在师父房间的前面。
你能找到吗？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
That girl...
will be sent to her home?
Don't worry about that.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
那个女孩...
会被送回家吗？
别担心那个。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Oh, it's perfect timing.
Mayshell will call you.
Go to the master's room.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
哦，时机正好。
梅谢尔会叫你的。
去师父的房间。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
What do you need?
We don't sell to anyone who has started the special task.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
你需要什么？
我们不卖给已经开始了特殊任务的人。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
You've completed the task perfectly.
What do you need now?
Do you need something else?
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
你完美地完成了任务。
现在你需要什么？
还需要别的吗？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Oh~ you're good-looking~!
It's worthwhile to open a pub~
I can feel fruitful labors whenever I see a guy like you~
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
哦~你长得真帅~！
开这家酒馆真是值得~
每次看到你这样的帅哥，我都觉得辛苦是值得的~

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Hmm... You look as good as I did in my youth.
What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
嗯...你看起来和我年轻时一样帅。
你想要什么？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Hum...you're a girl.
Ok pick up whatever you want.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
嗯...原来你是女孩啊。
好吧，随便挑你想要的。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
I'm not sure that you already know or not, but we are selling special Morocc liquor.
Which one do you want?
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
不知道你是否已经知道了，但我们正在出售特殊的摩洛哥酒。
你想要哪一种？

scripts.text: Tropical Sograt
scripts.translation: 热带的苏克拉特

scripts.text: Vermilion on the Beach
scripts.translation: 赤色海滩

scripts.text: No thanks!
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢！

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Here you are, take it.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
给你，拿好。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
It's 800 zeny per glass of Tropical Sograt.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
热带的苏克拉特每杯800 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Here you are, take it.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
给你，拿好。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
It's 800 zeny per glass of Vermilion on the Beach.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
赤色海滩每杯800 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Don't show me your nervousness!
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
别在我面前表现出紧张的样子！

scripts.text:
[Daora]
What? Why are you looking at me like that?
Oh? You are a person of this world.
Your name is...
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
什么？你为什么那样看着我？
哦？你是这个世界的人。
你的名字是...

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Ah~ I've heard your name before.
Umm... right!
You were recommended by Ahcart.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
啊~我好像听过你的名字。
嗯...对了！
你是阿卡特推荐来的。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
What, I don't know that name.
Hey, I have to be in business, so can you move over?
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
什么，我不认识这个名字。
喂，我得做生意，你能让开一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Yeah, can you find an entrance to an alley in the corner?
Go in there, then you can hear a more detailed story.
Take on this special task~!
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
对，你能找到角落里的巷子入口吗？
进去之后，就能听到更详细的故事了。
接受这个特殊任务吧~！

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Ah, I'm not selling liquir to someone who's started the special task.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
啊，我不卖酒给已经开始特殊任务的人。

scripts.text: Not selling liquor...
scripts.translation: 不卖酒...

scripts.text: I need information.
scripts.translation: 我需要资讯。

scripts.text: Fine then punk!
scripts.translation: 好吧，朽魔！

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Hey, you are performing a task now.
And you want me to sell you booze?!
Is every assasin like you? Lazy boozers?
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
喂，你现在正在执行任务。
还想让我卖酒给你？！
每个刺客都像你一样吗？懒散的酒鬼？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
You dare to demand information after taking a task.
You didn't meet a master yet?
As if I would just tell you because you ask!
You are childish.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
你接了任务还敢要求资讯。
你还没见过师父吧？
以为我随便问就会告诉你吗？
你太幼稚了。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Don't talk to me like I'm one of your friends!
You have no right to be that way!
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
别把我当成你的朋友那样说话！
你没有那样做的权利！

scripts.text: Yes,I did.
scripts.translation: 是的，我做了。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Hmm, I see...
Your opinion will be important.
I got it.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
嗯，我明白了...
你的意见很重要。
我知道了。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
She was so scared,
so I gave her a hot drink
and took her to a her room.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
她当时很害怕，
所以我给她倒了一杯热饮，
并把她带回了房间。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Well... there is better place to keep an eye on her than this room.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
嗯...没有比这个房间更合适的地方来照看她了。

scripts.text: No, I just protect...
scripts.translation: 不，我只是在保护...

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Ah~ whatever anyway you make me work.
To protect that young girl.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
啊~反正你让我干活。
去保护那个年轻女孩吧。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Mayshell told me that I have to support you, so I'm not going to complain.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
梅谢尔告诉我必须支持你，所以我不会抱怨。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
So, don't worry.
Are you supposed to be here for her?
Go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
所以，别担心。
你是为了她才在这里的吗？
去吧。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Mayshell and the other guys will handle it.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
梅谢尔和其他人会处理这件事的。

scripts.text: Give me 1 glass.
scripts.translation: 给我一杯。

scripts.text: Then, can you give milk?
scripts.translation: 那，能给我牛奶吗？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Why? Are you disappointed?
Um~
I can't let anyone on duty drink.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
为什么？你失望了？
嗯~
我不能让正在值班的人喝酒。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
I told you that I won't sell you any.
An empty glass is fine without liquor.
I already told you...
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
我告诉过你，我不会卖给你。
空杯子没有酒也是空的。
我已经说过了...

scripts.text:
[Daora]
You hope that there will be something in the glass?
Information can't come out of empty glasses.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
你希望杯子里有什么东西？
资讯不会从空杯子里冒出来。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
You need a glass?
Mayshell's order distracted you, so you can't understand anything.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
你需要一个杯子？
梅谢尔的指令让你分心了，所以你什么都听不懂。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
You seem to be worried.
Here, It's cold water.
You think over with cold water.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
你看起来很忧心。
给你，这是冷水。
喝点冷水冷静一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Wait in an alley where she usually shows up to find her, and you will be able to pursue the question.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
去她通常出现的那条小巷里等着，你就能找到她并继续追问了。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Did you solve it?
What will you do?
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
你解决了吗？
你打算怎么做？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
So, go to the east of village, you can see a narrow alley directed to the north.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
所以，去村庄的东边，你会看到一条向北延伸的小巷。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Haha... how's it going?
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
哈哈...进展如何？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
I sent a girl named Estillda to her home.
Why do we handle worthless things like it?
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
我派了一个叫艾丝蒂尔达的女孩去她家。
我们为什么要处理这种毫无价值的事情？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
The field northwest of Veins.
You can find that easily with a map.
There are lots of wolves, so be careful.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
伯仁斯西北方向的田野。
用地图很容易找到。
那里有很多狼，所以小心点。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Hey, how's Mayshell?
Can you fix an uncomfortable way of talking?
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
嘿，梅谢尔怎么样了？
你能改掉那种让人不舒服的说话方式吗？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
No. It's not funny anymore.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
不。这已经不好笑了。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
I'll let you know all the information that I know.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
我会告诉你我所知道的所有信息。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
If you need to, visit me anytime and I'll serve you a drink after your task is done.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
如果需要，随时来找我。任务完成后，我会请你喝一杯。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Ok, what do you want to know?
You hope that there will be something in the glass?
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
好的，你想知道什么？
你希望杯子里会有什么东西吗？

scripts.text: Ask for help.
scripts.translation: 寻求帮助

scripts.text: Handle it by yourself.
scripts.translation: 自己处理

scripts.text:
[Daora]
So, it means just killing a strange guy in the village?
Why were you in agony because of that?
Hmm... Let me see...
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
所以，意思就是只要杀掉村里那个奇怪的家伙？
你之前为什么为此如此痛苦？
嗯...让我想想...

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Then it will need legwork?
Where is the most crowded place in this village?
The pub and motel.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
那需要跑腿调查？
这个村子里最热闹的地方是哪里？
酒馆和旅馆。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
And the guard of the village always keeps an eye on strange people.
Or the old merchant is quick in visual learning.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
而且村里的卫兵总是盯着陌生人。
或者那个老商人观察力很敏锐。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
I can say that especially...
Trovan, Crave who is a trader, and Madelle in the pub are quick in visual learning.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
我可以特别指出...
特罗万、商人克雷夫，还有酒馆里的玛德勒，他们的观察力都很敏锐。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
It's good information, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
这是很好的信息，不是吗？

scripts.text: - The advice of Daora is attached to the board with quest information. -
scripts.translation: - 达奥拉的建议已贴在任务信息板上。 -

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Ok. It's great.
Each word and behavior will be an important key of the events.
So, look around carefully and figure it out.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
好的。太棒了。
每一句话和每一个行为都将是事件的关键。
所以，仔细看看周围，弄清楚情况。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Something good will happen.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
会有好事发生的。

scripts.text: Figure out based on information.
scripts.translation: 根据信息推断

scripts.text: Stop the stage.
scripts.translation: 停止调查

scripts.text: You stop the confirmation of information.
scripts.translation: 你停止了信息的确认。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Trying wouldn't hurt.
If you want to find a root, you have to find a leaf first.
Work hard.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
试一试也无妨。
若想找到根，就得先找到叶。
努力吧。

scripts.text: Get advice.
scripts.translation: 寻求建议

scripts.text: It's a secret.
scripts.translation: 这是秘密

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Can you let me know about an information you collected?
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
能告诉我你收集到的资讯吗？

scripts.text: You have a heart-to-heart talk with him.
scripts.translation: 与他推心置腹地交谈

scripts.text: That's impossible.
scripts.translation: 那是不可能的

scripts.text:
[Daora]
What, I can't support you properly?
You solve it by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
什么，我不能好好支持你吗？
那就自己解决吧。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Hum. Got it.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
嗯。明白了。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
There is a guy who looks like a priest and Trovan and Madelle saw him.
A merchant saw a girl who buys things regularly.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
有个看起来像牧师的男人，特罗万和玛德勒都见过他。
有个商人见过一个经常来买东西的女孩。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
The main target is a guy,
but the helper is a girl.
Maybe.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
主要目标是个男人，
但助手是个女孩。
大概是吧。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Above all,
it's really getting to you.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
最重要的是，
这件事真的让你很困扰。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Then it's simple.
Why don't you meet her in the place where she visits often?
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
那就简单了。
为什么不去她常去的地方见她呢？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
It's the transience of duty.
You don't know the meaning with a piece of the puzzle.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
这是职责的无常。
仅凭拼图的一角，你无法理解其含义。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
They can be related people or not.
Ok, I'll be very attentive to my want.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
他们可能是相关的人，也可能不是。
好吧，我会非常留意我的愿望。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Right~?
Go on a place where can look down a village well and find Melissa.
That will be helpful.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
对吧~？
去一个能俯瞰村庄的地方，找到梅丽莎。
那会有帮助的。

scripts.text: - Daora's advice is attached on the board of quest. -
scripts.translation: - 达奥拉的建议已附在任务板上。 -

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Umm~.
Right. There is a secret
you can't tell anyone while perfoming a task.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
嗯~。
没错。在执行任务时，
有一个不能告诉任何人的秘密。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
In those regards, you surpass the standards.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
在这方面，你超越了标准。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
The blind alley that Melissa told means this street.
You are thinking like a child.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
梅丽莎所说的死胡同指的是这条街。
你像个孩子一样思考。

scripts.text: Where is the blind alley?
scripts.translation: 死胡同在哪里？

scripts.text: It's okay.
scripts.translation: 没关系。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
The blind alley?
Hmm... well.
Is there a blind alley like our pub...
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
死胡同？
嗯...好吧。
是指像我们酒馆那样的死胡同吗...

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Ah, in the northeast alley
directed upside in the village,
there is no street because
the houses stand close together in that area.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
啊，在村庄东北方向的那条巷子里，
因为那里的房子建得很密集，
所以没有街道。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Around Melissa's house,
that is the blind alley
for the boy, maybe.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
在梅丽莎家附近，
那大概就是那个男孩所说的死胡同吧。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
It's very easy to find walking around the village.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
在村里四处走走，很容易就能找到。

scripts.text: - Daora's advice is attached on the board of quest. -
scripts.translation: - 达奥拉的建议已附在任务板上。 -

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Ok. It's going well.
Can I expect a good result?
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
好的，进展顺利。
我能期待一个好的结果吗？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
I'm not sure if he still lives...
Anyway, he is a key artisan in Rachel,
and can recognize all kinds of keys.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
我不确定他是否还住在那里...
总之，他是拉赫的关键工匠，
能识别各种各样的钥匙。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
What? Residence?
I told you, it's Rachel.
He maybe lives in comfort for the rest of his days in Rachel.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
什么？住所？
我告诉过你，是拉赫。
他可能在拉赫安度余生。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Go ask inside a pub of Rachel...
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
去拉赫的酒馆里面问问吧...

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Yeah, how's it going?
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
嗯，进展如何？

scripts.text: It progress satisfactorily.
scripts.translation: 进展顺利。

scripts.text: Show the key.
scripts.translation: 出示钥匙。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
My glass, you don't need it?
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
我的酒杯，你不需要吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I already have enough information.
If that is a stuff has a long story behind it,
we have only one way.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。我已经掌握了足够的信息。
如果那是一件有着漫长故事的东西，
我们只有一条路可走。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Right.
If you think carefully,
you can find a way.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
没错。
如果你仔细思考，
就能找到办法。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Good luck~
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
祝你好运~

scripts.text:
[Daora]
What is th--
I see, that guy had this key...?
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
这是什...
我明白了，那个家伙拿着这把钥匙...

scripts.text:
[Daora]
It's a symbol of shrines
and has a showy pattern.
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
这是神龛的象征，
有着华丽的图案。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Daora]
So, you want to know this key's use?
If you do, go to Rachel.
There is a key artisan there.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
所以，你想知道这把钥匙的用途？
如果是的话，去拉赫吧。
那里有一位钥匙工匠。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Now, he is retired, but he
spends his declining years in peace.
You can ask him yourself.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
现在他已退休，
正在那里安度晚年。
你可以亲自去问他。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Ask what this key's use is.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
询问这把钥匙的用途。

scripts.text: - Daora's advice is attached on the quest board. -
scripts.translation: - 达奥拉的建议贴在任务板上。 -

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Don't pretend to be a noblewoman.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
别装成什么贵族小姐了。

scripts.text: I'm going to go.
scripts.translation: 我要走了。

scripts.text: Do you know a mansion around Veins?
scripts.translation: 你知道伯仁斯附近有什么豪宅吗？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Ok.
Don't be carried away by ill-advised bravery.
Well... it's also hard to be killed.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
好的。
别一时冲动，鲁莽行事。
嗯...不过想死也不容易。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Yes, sure.
There is a mansion between ravines.
It's very gloomy.
I don't understand his taste.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
是的，当然知道。
在峡谷之间有一座豪宅。
那里非常阴森。
我不懂他的品味。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
And that mansion is built in back of a ravine...
It's always dark like the night.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
而且那座豪宅建在峡谷后面...
那里总是像夜晚一样黑暗。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
The location?
Well...
It's in the northwest field of Veins.
You can go through a narrow road to northeast.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
位置吗？
嗯...
在伯仁斯西北方的田野里。
你可以沿着一条小路往东北方向走。

scripts.text: - Daora's advice is attached on the board of quest. -
scripts.translation: - 达奥拉的建议已附在任务板上。 -

scripts.text:
[Daora]
There are lots of scary wolves in that area, be careful.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
那个区域有很多可怕的狼，小心点。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Our milk is expensive!
Give me 500 zeny for a cup.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
我们的牛奶很贵的！
一杯要500 Zeny。

scripts.text: It's ok. Give me a cup of milk.
scripts.translation: 好吧，给我来一杯牛奶。

scripts.text: You are a barefaced robber!
scripts.translation: 你这强盗！

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Here you are. Milk.
Then take a rest.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
给你。牛奶。
那就休息一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
I told you, it's 500 zeny.
A poor man. You have only a fine figure!
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
我说了，是500 Zeny。
真穷。除了长得好看，你还有什么？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
An impertinent fellow!
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
无礼的家伙！

scripts.text:
[Daora]
If you decide on a way to walk, it's time to start newly.
Everyone is waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
既然决定了要走的路，就该重新出发了。
大家都在等你。

scripts.text: Tropical Sograt
scripts.translation: 热带的苏克拉特

scripts.text: Vermilion on the Beach
scripts.translation: 赤色海滩

scripts.text: Milk
scripts.translation: 牛奶

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Here you are, take it.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
给你，拿好。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
It's 800 zeny per 1 glass of Tropical Sograt.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
热带的苏克拉特一杯800 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Here you are, take it.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
给你，拿好。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
[Daora]
It's 800 zeny per 1 glass of Vermilion on the Beach.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
赤色海滩一杯800 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Uh... Umm...
It's complicated order. but I don't have any choice since you want it.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
呃...嗯...
这个订单有点复杂。但既然您想要，我也别无选择。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Ah, milk.
Huu! Milk!
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
啊，牛奶。
呼！牛奶！

scripts.text:
[Daora]
I feel sorry to take 500 zeny per bottle, but I have to.
It's very hard to get milk in Veins.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
一瓶收500 Zeny，虽然我觉得有点抱歉，但我必须这么做。
在伯仁斯，牛奶非常难弄到。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Umm... I think I can't help you.
There is no milk in Veins.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
嗯...我想我帮不了您。
伯仁斯没有牛奶。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
I don't have anything like that.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
我没有那种东西。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
I'm not sure that you already know or not, but we are selling special liquor of Morocc.
Which one do you want?
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
我不确定您是否已经知道，但我们正在出售摩洛哥的特制烈酒。
您想要哪一种？

scripts.text: Tropical Sograt
scripts.translation: 热带的苏克拉特

scripts.text: Vermilion the beach
scripts.translation: 赤色海滩

scripts.text: No thanks!
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢！

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Here you are, take it.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
给你，拿好。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
It's 1000 zeny per glass of Tropical Sograt.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
热带的苏克拉特一杯1000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Here you are, take it.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
给你，拿好。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
It's 1000 zeny per glass of Vermilion on the Beach.
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
赤色海滩一杯1000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Don't show me your nervousness!
scripts.translation:
[达奥拉]
别在我面前表现出紧张的样子！

scripts.text: - You can't continue this quest because you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您的物品栏已满，无法继续此任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
You were sent here by Ahcart?
I'll give you a task without asking anymore questions.
Ok, listen carefully.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
您是阿卡特派您来的？
我不再多问，直接给您一个任务。
好，仔细听。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
You already have your orders.
Even though you don't have any evidence, I trust you to do a good job.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
您已经收到指令了。
虽然您没有任何证据，但我相信您能做好这份工作。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
Welcome.
How was your day?
I heard about your activity.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
欢迎。
您今天过得怎么样？
我听说您的行为了。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
Ok, you have something to do?
If you are late, Renzak might get upset.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
好的，您有事要做吗？
如果您迟到了，伦扎克可能会不高兴。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
I already got a report from Renzak.
I'm so happy to see you.
But quickness is very important to us.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
我已经收到伦扎克的报告了。
很高兴见到您。
但速度对我们来说非常重要。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
I already got a report from Renzak.
You completed the task quickly.
That's great.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
我已经收到伦扎克的报告了。
您很快完成了任务。
这很好。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
You are acknowledged by the guild.
Feel free to come whenever you want to become a Guillotine Cross.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
您已被公会认可。
如果您想成为十字斩首者，随时欢迎前来。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
Even though I gave you a qualification,
I don't want to celebrate that qualification.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
虽然我给了您资格，
但我并不想庆祝这个资格。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
You are not allowed in here.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
您不允许进入这里。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
We are chasing a person trying to dissolve an organization.
We got information about a guy who looks like a town leader.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
我们正在追捕一个试图解散组织的人。
我们得到情报，说有一个看起来像城镇首领的家伙。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
Your task is to punish him under the cover of shadow.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
你的任务是在阴影中惩罚他。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
Our objective shouldn't be released to anybody.
Your memories should disappear in shadow.
Be cautious and avoid observation.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
我们的目标绝不能泄露给任何人。
你的记忆应消失在阴影中。
保持警惕，避免被监视。

scripts.text: Ok...
scripts.translation: 好的...

scripts.text: So the task is...?
scripts.translation: 那么任务是...

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
What does he look like?
How do you recognize him?
I can't tell you.
That's for you to find out.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
他长什么样？
你怎么认出他？
我无法告诉你。
那是你需要自己发现的。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
You will need a compass.
You need a lamp and a light to see in the darkness.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
你需要一个指南针。
你需要一盏灯和光源，以便在黑暗中看清。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
At that point, you will be able to have a drink and rest.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
到那时，你就可以喝点东西休息一下了。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
Overcome the adversity.
It is up to you to judge.
We can't help you, so you must figure it out for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
克服逆境。
由你来判断。
我们无法帮助你，所以你必须自己想办法。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
We saw a stranger in this village, we are quite sure that he is the person who we are looking for your task.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
我们在这个村庄看到了一个陌生人，我们相当确定他就是我们要找的人，也就是你的任务目标。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
{0}.
Time is not waiting for you.
Go ahead. Spill blood with the blade of a knife that stands for a stoic life.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
{0}。
时间不会等你。
去吧。用象征坚忍生命的刀刃，溅出鲜血。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
It's a test to watch you.
Let me see, {0}...
Go out and think about what you have to do first.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
这是一场观察你的考验。
让我看看，{0}...
先出去想想你要做什么。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
Your task is finding a stranger.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
你的任务是寻找一个陌生人。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
Go out search diligently.
I'll allow you to have some water.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
出去仔细搜索。
我允许你喝点水。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
Meet Daora before you start.
She may be helpful to you.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
开始之前先见见达奥拉。
她可能会对你有所帮助。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
You found a key, right?
Huhu. I have my ways of finding out.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
你找到钥匙了，对吧？
呵呵。我有我的办法。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
Can you show me the key?
I'm going to check if
you were capable or not...
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
你能把钥匙给我看看吗？
我要检查一下
你是否具备能力...

scripts.text: Give a key to him.
scripts.translation: 把钥匙给他

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
You didn't bring a key?
I'll be in lots of trouble.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
你没带钥匙？
这会让我陷入大麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
I didn't expect your success without a clear target...
You are a man of greater ability than I thought.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
没想到你在没有明确目标的情况下成功了...
你比我想象的更有能力。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
I think you find a target what we look for.
Then you handle it after finding a key's host.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
我想你找到了我们要找的目标。
那么，在找到钥匙的主人之后，由你来处理他。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
Then it'll be over.
But you have to find the key's host by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
那么，一切就结束了。
但你要自己找到钥匙的主人。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
When you find the mansion, there will be a person waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
当你找到那座宅邸时，会有人在那里等你。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
This is the last step.
Don't make any mistakes.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
这是最后一步。
千万不要出错。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
You were not punctual...
At least you came back alive.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
你不够准时...
至少你还活着回来了。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
You did the job by yourself
even though there wasn't any
information about it, and you
collected it.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
尽管没有任何情报，
你还是独自完成了任务，
并收集到了它。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
You made full use of Daora's advice.
But, didn't I mention it?
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
你充分利用了达奥拉的建议。
但我不是提过吗？

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
You corresponded with all conditions
promptly and with patience.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
你迅速且耐心地
满足了所有条件。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
The evaluation of your task is... [S].
[S] is for 'special'.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
你的任务评价是... [S]。
[S]代表“特别”。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
The evaluation of your task is... [A].
If you were punctual, you would have received higher.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
你的任务评价是... [A]。
如果你能准时，评价会更高。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
I told you to keep it a secret...
Of course, I don't want to blame you.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
我告诉过你要保守秘密...
当然，我不想责怪你。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
It's important not only to solve this by yourself,
but also to make an effort getting information.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
重要的是，不仅要独自解决这件事，
还要努力获取情报。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
The evaluation of your task is... [B].
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
你的任务评价是... [B]。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
The evaluation of your task is... [C].
You need to act by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
你的任务评价是... [C]。
你需要独立行动。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
You adjusted an affair with flexible points of view.
You were not dependent on the others and you used the surroundings properly.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
你以灵活的视角处理了事务。
你没有依赖他人，
并合理利用了周围环境。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
I like that.
The evaluation of your task is... [A].
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
我喜欢这样。
你的任务评价是... [A]。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
I like that.
The evaluation of your task is... [B].
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
我喜欢这样。
你的任务评价是... [B]。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
You got a new qualification for completing this task.
It's a shadow of our assasin as a shadow of the world...
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
完成此任务后，你获得了一项新资格。
它是世界阴影中，
我们刺客的阴影...

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
I'm going to give you the qualification to be a ^4d4dffGuillotine Cross^000000.
I'm not pushing you, so you can come whenever you want to visit.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
我将授予你成为^4d4dff十字斩首者^000000的资格。
我不强迫你，你想什么时候来都可以。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
I reward you for your labor, and I'm going to give you a present.
I got this one from guild, I hope it's helpful to you.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
为了奖励你的辛劳，
我要送你一份礼物。
这是我从公会拿来的，
希望对你有用。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
I want to tell you something.
I order you that ^4d4dffyou should not leave a document at all^000000, whatever it is.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
我有件事想告诉你。
我命令你^4d4dff绝对不要留下任何文件^000000，无论是什么。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
There are two types of information:
Things that can be shared and those that cannot.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
情报分为两种：
可以分享的，和不能分享的。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
And never leave records or tell anybody about a task you completed...
for your junior who will follow your steps.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
而且，永远不要留下记录，也不要告诉任何人你完成的任务...
为了那些将追随你脚步的后辈。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
Don't forget.
And the task you did is related to Rachel, Rune-Midgarts, and our assassin guild.
So the others should not be known. Of course, you are included, so please forget everything.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
别忘了。
你执行的任务与拉赫、卢恩·米德加兹以及我们的刺客公会有关。
所以其他人不应该知道。当然，你也包括在内，请忘记一切。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
That choice means that you will have to walk a street of blood again.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
做出这个选择，意味着你将再次踏上血路。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
Bercasell is waiting in the room on the opposite side.
Meet him.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
贝卡塞尔正在对面的房间等待。
去见他吧。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
It's a way to abandon one's mind and the way of pain, of adversity.
I pushed you that way.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
这是一种抛弃心智，走向痛苦与逆境的方式。
是我把你推向了那条路。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
It's funny.
We live for checking our comrades...
But it's a rule of the assasin.
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
真讽刺。
我们活着就是为了监视同志...
但这正是刺客的规矩。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
In a dark night, it's the fate of a person who is going on the shadow of the moon.
I wish you to store one's mind, please...
scripts.translation:
[梅谢尔]
在漆黑的夜晚，这是行走在月影之下的人的命运。
请收起你的心智...

scripts.text:
[Waitress]
Welcome~
Visit and take a rest~
scripts.translation:
[女服务员]
欢迎光临~
请随意入座休息~

scripts.text:
[Waitress]
That's all the information that I know.
After that, I can't remember anything else.
scripts.translation:

So we should exclude normal guests...
scripts.translation:
[特罗万]
而且如果达奥拉发现了一个人，那肯定不是普通人。
所以我们应该排除普通的客人...

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
Then we can set limits for guessing who it is.
A few days ago, a priest visited this village.
He covered his face with a hood, so I couldn't see him too well.
scripts.translation:
[特罗万]
这样我们就能缩小猜测的范围了。
几天前，有一位牧师来过这个村庄。
他用兜帽遮住了脸，所以我没看清他的长相。

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
I can detect suspicious people pretty well.
He might be a criminal if he were hiding his face.
scripts.translation:
[特罗万]
我挺擅长发现可疑人物的。
如果他遮住脸，可能就是个罪犯。

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
Why is he suspicious?
He shows up here regularly, but he has no definite residence.
And I always lose him when I try to follow him.
scripts.translation:
[特罗万]
他为什么可疑？
他经常来这里，但没有固定的住所。
而且每次我想跟踪他，都会跟丢。

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
I can't offer any more information.
I always have to guard the entrance of the village, so I can't follow him for too long.
scripts.translation:
[特罗万]
我没法提供更多情报了。
我必须一直看守村庄入口，所以没法长时间跟踪他。

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
Anyway. He is a only person who I suspect.
He hasn't been caught doing anything criminal,
but he's always covering himself up.
scripts.translation:
[特罗万]
总之。他是唯一让我怀疑的人。
虽然没抓到他做什么坏事，
但他总是把自己遮得严严实实的。

scripts.text: - Trovan's information is attached to the quest board. What information have I collected? -
scripts.translation: - 特罗万的情报已附在任务板上。我收集了哪些情报？ -

scripts.text: Check information.
scripts.translation: 查看资讯

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: You stop the confirmation of information.
scripts.translation: 你停止了信息的确认。

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
Recently, I've seen many suspicious people.
I'm keeping strict watch.
scripts.translation:
[特罗万]
最近，我见过很多可疑的人。
我正在严密监视。

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
I already gave you all the information I have.
He's the only suspicious person that's been seen.
But nothing has happened yet, so I'm keeping watch.
scripts.translation:
[特罗万]
我已经把我知道的所有情报都给你了。
他是唯一被目击到的可疑人物。
但还没发生什么事，所以我正在监视他。

scripts.text: - Should I figure out the information collected? -
scripts.translation: - 我要整理一下收集到的情报吗？ -

scripts.text: Check the information.
scripts.translation: 查看情报

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: You stop the confirmation of information.
scripts.translation: 你停止了信息的确认。

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
I'm Trovan, a guard of Veins.
What's wrong?
scripts.translation:
[特罗万]
我是特罗万，伯仁斯的卫兵。
怎么了？

scripts.text: Is there a wanted man?
scripts.translation: 有通缉犯吗？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
A wanted man?
No, what's the matter?
scripts.translation:
[特罗万]
通缉犯？
没有啊，怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
Did you find any suspicious people entering this village lately?
Umm...
scripts.translation:
[特罗万]
你最近发现有什么可疑的人进入这个村庄吗？
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
Recently, there's been a man in this village wearing a hood.
He is not a traveler. He bought food and slipped out of the village.
scripts.translation:
[特罗万]
最近村里来了个戴兜帽的男人。
他不是旅行者，买了些食物后就悄悄离开了村庄。

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
I'm wondering about his identity.
I think he is related to a shrine...
Or maybe he isn't...
scripts.translation:
[特罗万]
我在琢磨他的身份。
我觉得他和神龛有点关系...
也许不是吧...

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
There is no one else like him among the people living in this village.
I wonder where he is from.
scripts.translation:
[特罗万]
村里没有和他长得像的人。
不知道他是从哪里来的。

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
He might still be here.
There are no new people except for him. I know almost all of the adventurer's faces that visit here.
So that's not much news.
scripts.translation:
[特罗万]
他可能还在附近。
除了他，没有新面孔。我几乎认识所有来这里的冒险者。
所以这不算什么大新闻。

scripts.text: - Trovan's information is attached to the quest board. What information have I collected? -
scripts.translation: - 特罗万的情报已附在任务板上。我收集了哪些情报？ -

scripts.text: Check information.
scripts.translation: 查看资讯

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: You stop the confirmation of information.
scripts.translation: 你停止了信息的确认。

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
Don't go too far away.
scripts.translation:
[特罗万]
别走太远。

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
How's it going?
scripts.translation:
[特罗万]
最近怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
What a huge sandstorm.
Are you ok?
scripts.translation:
[货郎]
好大的沙尘暴啊。
你没事吧？

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
So, did you find that girl?
If you do, let her know that she has to come and visit me.
scripts.translation:
[货郎]
那么，你找到那个女孩了吗？
如果找到了，告诉她一定要来找我。

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
Hey. Hey!
I'm talking to you!
scripts.translation:
[货郎]
嘿。嘿！
我在跟你说话呢！

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
Did you send my message properly?
Then why she hasn't she visited here to exchange the fish?
scripts.translation:
[货郎]
你好好把我的话传给她了吗？
那她为什么还没来换鱼？

scripts.text: - You can't get more information from the peddler. What information have I collected? -
scripts.translation: - 你无法从货郎那里获得更多信息。我收集了哪些信息？ -

scripts.translation: 查看信息

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: You stop the confirmation of information.
scripts.translation: 你停止了信息的确认。

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text: Listen to the story.
scripts.translation: 听故事

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
You are too cold.
scripts.translation:
[货郎]
你太冷淡了。

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
A pretty girl just bought food.
You know that freshness is important when buying fish...
scripts.translation:
[货郎]
刚才有个漂亮女孩买了食物。
你知道买鱼最重要的是新鲜...

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
But I gave the wrong fish to her.
Recently, she bought food from my store.
I can't find her, maybe she doesn't live here.
scripts.translation:
[货郎]
但我给她拿错了鱼。
最近她一直在我的店里买东西。
我找不到她，也许她不住在这里。

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
She looks shabby but she always buys expensive food.
I thought that she was a maid but we don't have a mansion that can hire maids in Veins.
scripts.translation:
[货郎]
她看起来有点寒酸，但总是买很贵的食物。
我以为她是女仆，但伯仁斯没有能雇得起女仆的豪宅。

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
Kind of suspicious, isn't it?
But, I gave spoiled fish to her...
scripts.translation:
[货郎]
有点可疑，不是吗？
但是，我给了她变质的鱼...

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
So I have to find her and exchange the fish for a refund.
scripts.translation:
[货郎]
所以我必须找到她，把鱼换掉并退款。

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
If you find her, send that message, please?
I can't miss a guest like her.
scripts.translation:
[货郎]
如果你找到她，请帮我传个话好吗？
我可不想错过像她这样的客人。

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
Ok, let's see...
She is blonde girl.
You should be able
to find her easily.
scripts.translation:
[货郎]
好的，让我想想...
她是个金发女孩。
你应该很容易就能找到她。

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
Actually, nobody knows where she's from.
You're an adventurer, so I'm asking you.
scripts.translation:
[货郎]
其实，没人知道她是从哪里来的。
你是冒险者，所以我想问问你。

scripts.text: I'll send her your message.
scripts.translation: 我会把你的话转告给她。

scripts.text: Hmm...

[{0}]
- Even though I don't have time to spare, the girl mentioned by the peddler is suspicious. -
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
- 虽然我很忙，但货郎提到的那个女孩很可疑。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
- A girl who has no clear residence and buys expensive food. I have to find out. -
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
- 一个没有固定住所却买昂贵食物的女孩。我必须查清楚。 -

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
Then send my message to her, please.
If I can't exchange the fish, it will spoil.
scripts.translation:
[货郎]
那么，请帮我转告她。
如果换不了鱼，它们就会变质的。

scripts.text: - The peddler's information is attached to the quest board. What information have I collected? -
scripts.translation: - 货郎的资讯已附在任务板上。我收集到了什么资讯？ -

scripts.translation: 查看资讯

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.translation: 你停止了信息的确认。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Haha... I can remember my past when I see a young adventurer like you...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
哈哈...看到你这样的年轻冒险者，让我想起了我的过去...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Thanks for talking to me.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
谢谢你跟我说话。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
What? What's the matter?
You want to talk with me?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
什么？怎么了？
你想跟我说话？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
You want to know something?
We have a marvelous girl in our village.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
你想知道什么？
我们村里有个很棒的女孩。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I still don't know.
I'm too old...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我还不清楚。
我太老了...

scripts.text: - I can't get anymore information from the Old Man. What information have I collected? -
scripts.translation: - 我没法从老人那里得到更多资讯了。我收集到了什么资讯？ -

scripts.text: Check information.
scripts.translation: 查看资讯

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: You stop the confirmation of information.
scripts.translation: 你停止了信息的确认。

scripts.text: Suspicious person...
scripts.translation: 可疑的人...

scripts.text: You look good.
scripts.translation: 你看起来不错。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
A suspicious person?
Well, Trovan may know more about her than me.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
可疑的人？
嗯，特罗万可能比我更了解她。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Thanks anyway.
I'll just sit down here...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
还是谢谢你了。
我就坐在这里吧...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I look around at people who pass by here all the time.
I can find out where they're from easily by watching what they wear.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我一直看着从这里经过的人。
通过看他们的穿着，我很容易就能知道他们来自哪里。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I can't forget her at all because of her funny outfit.
It's not difficult to forget a person wearing a formal dress.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
因为她的穿着很滑稽，我完全忘不了她。
穿着正式礼服的人很难让人忘记。

scripts.text: Then what's funny?
scripts.translation: 那哪里滑稽？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Umm, this village is not funny anymore.
I know everything~ I even found out everyone's job.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
嗯，这个村庄一点也不滑稽。
我什么都知道~ 我甚至查清了每个人的职业。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
But...
Recently, a girl showed up.
In the morning, she buys some food from a peddler and then disappears.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
但是...
最近出现了一个女孩。
早上，她从货郎那里买些食物，然后就消失了。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
And in the afternoon she usually buys the necessities of life.
A little bit at a time.
And then she goes somewhere after...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
下午她通常会买些生活必需品。
每次只买一点点。
然后她就去了某个地方...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I figure that she must be preparing something.
If she buys a lot of stuff, then she can be found easily.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我觉得她一定是在准备什么东西。
如果她买很多东西，那就很容易找到她了。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I think she stocks up heavily on foods that help during battles.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我想她大量囤积了在战斗中有帮助的食物。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
She just recently started this routine.
Is she a newcomer?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
她最近才开始这种习惯。
她是新来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I'm going to watch you for a while.
Ah, why am I bothering you with this story?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我要盯着你看一会儿。
啊，我为什么要拿这个故事烦你呢？

scripts.text: - The information of the Old Man is attached to the quest board. What information have I collected?
scripts.translation: - 老人的资讯已附在任务板上。我收集了什么资讯？

scripts.text: Check information.
scripts.translation: 查看资讯

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: You stop the confirmation of information.
scripts.translation: 你停止了信息的确认。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I don't know what kind of gift she has, but she knows how to find people.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我不知道她有什么天赋，但她很会找人。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
If you want to find her, ask that kid.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
如果你想找她，去问那个小孩。

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Hi?
What?
Have you lost a friend?
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
嗨？
什么？
你丢了朋友？

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Did you find her?
Say thanks to her for giving me candy the other day.
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
你找到她了吗？
替我谢谢她前几天给我的糖果。

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
When I'm looking for people, an angel wearing black clothes gives me information.
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
当我找人时，一个穿黑衣服的天使会给我提供资讯。

scripts.text: Do you know something?
scripts.translation: 你知道些什么？

scripts.text: No...
scripts.translation: 没有...

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
I have a special gift that I've had my whole life.
People visit me when they need to find something.
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
我有一种与生俱来的特殊天赋。
人们需要找东西时会来找我。

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Are looking for someone?
Can you tell me about their character?
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
你在找人吗？
能告诉我他们的性格吗？

scripts.text: You are joking.
scripts.translation: 你在开玩笑。

scripts.text: Let me do it.
scripts.translation: 让我去做。

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Ha! But you'll come back to me when you need to find someone.
I know everything.
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
哈！但当你需要找人时，你会回到我这里的。
我什么都知道。

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Ok, answer my question.
Is it a boy or a girl?
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
好，回答我的问题。
是男孩还是女孩？

scripts.text: A boy
scripts.translation: 男孩

scripts.text: A girl
scripts.translation: 女孩

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
A boy and...
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
男孩，还有...

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
A girl and...
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
女孩，还有...

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
What is the hair color?
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
发色是什么？

scripts.text: Dark
scripts.translation: 深色

scripts.text: Red
scripts.translation: 红色

scripts.text: Light yellowish
scripts.translation: 浅黄色

scripts.text: White
scripts.translation: 白色

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Dark hair color... hmm...
Dark brown or black hair...
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
深色头发...嗯...
深棕色或黑色头发...

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Light brown or dark orange... Red hair...
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
浅棕色或深橙色...红发...

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Light orange to blonde hair.
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
浅橙色到金色头发。

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Gray... white... gold... silver hair...
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
灰色...白色...金色...银色头发...

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Young or old?
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
年轻还是年老？

scripts.text: Like a child.
scripts.translation: 像孩子一样

scripts.text: Young.
scripts.translation: 年轻

scripts.text: Middle-aged.
scripts.translation: 中年

scripts.text: Very old.
scripts.translation: 非常老

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
And a child.
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
是个孩子。

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
A young person.
Like you?
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
年轻人。
像你一样？

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Same age as a tool salesman?
Middle-aged.
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
和工具销售员一样的年纪？
中年。

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Yes, very old.
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
是的，非常老。

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Hi, {0}~ Let me collect all of the information you've provided...
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
你好，{0}~ 让我整理一下你提供的信息...

scripts.text: - She begins to murmur and gestures toward the sky. Her hair springs up as she says... -
scripts.translation: - 她开始低声呢喃，并指向天空。她的头发突然竖了起来，说道... -

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Got it!
I know her.
Her name is ^4d4dffEstillda^000000.
Right?
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
明白了！
我认识她。
她的名字是^4d4dff艾丝蒂尔达^000000。
对吗？

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Why are you looking for her? Is she your friend?
She gave me candy the other day.
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
你为什么要找她？她是你的朋友吗？
前几天她还给我糖果了呢。

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Umm... this girl...
will pass around
a blind alley in
about 1 hour!
Hehehe!
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
嗯...这个女孩...
大概1小时后
会经过那条
死胡同！
嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
She has to be who you're looking for. I'm never wrong.
Tell me I did a good job!
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
她肯定就是你要找的人。我从不会错的。
快夸我做得好！

scripts.text: Pat Melissa on the head.
scripts.translation: 摸摸梅丽莎的头

scripts.text: Giver her a thumbs up sign.
scripts.translation: 给她竖个大拇指

scripts.text:
You pat Melissa on the head.
She reacts like a puppy would.
scripts.translation:
你摸了摸梅丽莎的头。
她像小狗一样做出了反应。

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Hehehe...
I'm here to help~!
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
嘿嘿嘿...
我来帮忙啦~！

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Hehehe...
I did good!
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
嘿嘿嘿...
我做得很好吧！

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Umm...
That person who has those characteristics is...
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
嗯...
那个符合这些特征的人是...

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Wha-...? Eww, I've never been wrong.
I don't know why, but I can't see that person.
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
什...？哎呀，我从不会错的。
不知道为什么，我看不到那个人。

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Eeeahhh! Wahhh!
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
呜呜呜！哇哇哇！

scripts.text: - All I can do is soothe Melissa as she cries. I have to think about the person's characteristics again. -
scripts.translation: - 我只能安慰哭泣的梅丽莎。我得重新想想那个人的特征。 -

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
It's strange.
In this village people are always looking for someone.
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
真奇怪。
在这个村庄，人们总是在寻找某个人。

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
I told Daora about this story, then she said to me not to do it again.
Maybe she isn't a good angel.
scripts.translation:
[梅丽莎]
我把这件事告诉了达奥拉，然后她让我不要再这样做了。
也许她不是一个好天使。

scripts.text:
.....?
There's a sign of somebody present.
You still have time.
scripts.translation:
.....？
那里有人的气息。
你还有时间。

scripts.text: The blind alley that Melissa told me about must be this street.
scripts.translation: 梅丽莎告诉我的那条死胡同，应该就是这条街。

scripts.text:
There's a sign of somebody present.
A blonde girl shows up!
scripts.translation:
那里有人的气息。
一个金发女孩出现了！

scripts.text: Make a surprise attack.
scripts.translation: 发动突袭

scripts.text:
You take her by the wrist trying not to let her see you.
The food that she is holding falls on the floor.
scripts.translation:
你抓住她的手腕，尽量不让她看见你。
她手中的食物掉在了地上。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
Ahhhh!
Who are you?
What are you doing?
scripts.translation:
[艾丝蒂尔达]
啊！
你是谁？
你在干什么？

scripts.text: Who sent you?
scripts.translation: 谁派你来的？

scripts.text: Who's from Rachel?
scripts.translation: 你是拉赫的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
I don't know! I don't have any idea. I don't know him!
scripts.translation:
[艾丝蒂尔达]
我不知道！我完全不知道。我不认识他！

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
If I buy stuff for him...
He said that he can pay for my labor and production costs.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝蒂尔达]
如果我给他买这些东西...
他说他会支付我的劳动费和材料费。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
I don't know who he is.
It's true.
Is he bad guy?
scripts.translation:
[艾丝蒂尔达]
我真的不知道他是谁。
这是真的。
他是坏人吗？

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
Help me, please?
Help me.
I'll do anything you want.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝蒂尔达]
求求你帮帮我？
帮帮我。
你让我做什么我都愿意。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
I didn't know anything about him, I don't know if he's a bad guy.
I just bought some stuff... (sobbing)...
scripts.translation:
[艾丝蒂尔达]
我对他一无所知，我不知道他是不是坏人。
我只是买了点东西...（哭泣）...

scripts.text: - Estillda is in shock because she thinks that she's in trouble. -
scripts.translation: - 艾丝蒂尔达处于震惊状态，因为她觉得自己要惹上麻烦了。 -

scripts.text: Calm her down.
scripts.translation: 安抚她

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Just relax for a second.
I totally understand what you're saying.
You won't get into any trouble.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
先冷静一下。
我完全理解你的处境。
你不会惹上麻烦的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm looking for a guy who committed a crime and ran away.
I have to catch him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在追捕一个犯了罪后逃跑的家伙。
我必须抓住他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So who made you get those supplies?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么，是谁让你去买那些物资的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you cooperate with me, I'm going to protect you until this is all done.
The Assassin Guild will protect you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你配合我，我会保护你直到事情结束。
刺客公会会保护你。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
You promise, right?
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[艾丝蒂尔达]
你保证吗？
我该怎么帮你？

scripts.text: When are you supposed to meet?
scripts.translation: 你们约好什么时候见面？

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
Oh, I already delivered the stuff.
I'm on my way back.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝蒂尔达]
哦，我已经把东西送过去了。
我正在回来的路上。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
Ah, these are mine.
I got a lot of zeny.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝蒂尔达]
啊，这些是我的。
我赚了很多Zeny。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then go straight this way and pretend that nothing happened.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那就沿着这条路直走，假装什么都没发生。

scripts.text: - I demand that she walks as usual and tell her how to get to Daora's pub. -
scripts.translation: - 我要求她像往常一样走路，并告诉她怎么去达奥拉的酒馆。 -

scripts.text: - The pub in the underground of Veins is the best place to keep her safe. -
scripts.translation: - 伯仁斯地下的酒馆是保护她最安全的地方。 -

scripts.text: - I tried to take her by the wrist, but she already knew and ran away screaming. -
scripts.translation: - 我试图抓住她的手腕，但她早有防备，尖叫着逃跑了。 -

scripts.text: You couldn't catch Estillda.
scripts.translation: 你没能抓住艾丝蒂尔达。

scripts.text:
An error has occurred.
Please contact the GM team to fix this situation.
scripts.translation:
发生了一个错误。
请联系GM团队解决此问题。

scripts.text: Estillda is looking around with an anxious expression on her face.
scripts.translation: 艾丝蒂尔达神情焦虑地四处张望。

scripts.text: Are you ok?
scripts.translation: 你还好吗？

scripts.text: Intimidate her.
scripts.translation: 抄袭她

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
Yes? Yes...
I thought assassins were scary.
But I don't think so...
scripts.translation:
[艾丝蒂尔达]
是...是的...
我以为刺客很可怕。
但我觉得...好像也不是...

scripts.text: You don't look like you're from Veins
scripts.translation: 你看起来不像伯仁斯人

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
Yes? Yes...
I'm from Rachel.
I'm here to make zeny.
I had a desolate life in Rachel.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝蒂尔达]
是...是的...
我来自拉赫。
我来这里是为了赚Zeny。
我在拉赫过着凄惨的生活。

scripts.text: You came here with alone?
scripts.translation: 你是一个人来的吗？

scripts.text: Had a desolate life...
scripts.translation: 凄惨的生活...

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
No.
I don't think so.
I came here with a guy.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝蒂尔达]
不。
我不这么认为。
我是和一个男人一起来的。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
I usually come here by myself. Sometimes he checks my destination.
I thought that he is an important person from some company.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝蒂尔达]
我通常都是一个人来。有时候他会确认我的目的地。
我以为他是某家公司的要人。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
But I don't know who he is.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝蒂尔达]
但我不知道他是谁。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
I'm a native,
I work in his house.
I think it's not bad.
I just left my home...
scripts.translation:
[艾丝蒂尔达]
我是本地人，
在他家里工作。
我觉得还不错。
我只是离开了家...

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
He said that he needed a maid and that he could pay me enough money.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝蒂尔达]
他说他需要一名女仆，而且能给我足够的钱。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
Actually I don't know him well.
...I'll never do it.
I want to go home. I miss my mommy.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝蒂尔达]
其实我并不了解他。
...我绝不会那样做。
我想回家。我想妈妈了。

scripts.text: What can you tell me?
scripts.translation: 你能告诉我什么？

scripts.text: Tell me what you know!
scripts.translation: 告诉我你知道的一切！

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
Yes. Right?
I'm going to tell you everything that I know.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝蒂尔达]
是的。对吧？
我会把我知道的一切都告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
Sorry. I'm sorry.
I'm going to do what you want...
scripts.translation:
[艾丝蒂尔达]
对不起。真的很抱歉。
我会照您说的做...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your attitude is a problem.
Let's take up the main subject.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你的态度有问题。
我们言归正传吧。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
I usually supply food
and other life necessities.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝蒂尔达]
我平时负责供应食物
和其他生活必需品。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
I buy some food to eat for myself.
And I buy expensive food for him everyday.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝蒂尔达]
我会买些食物自己吃。
然后每天给他买很贵的食物。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
I think he is very fussy about food...
And I get money whenever I deliver food..
scripts.translation:
[艾丝蒂尔达]
我觉得他对食物很挑剔...
而且我每次送食物都能拿到钱。

scripts.text: Where did you sleep?
scripts.translation: 你睡在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
Yes? Yes, around here.
There is a place that soldiers stay.
He wants me to stay there...
scripts.translation:
[艾丝蒂尔达]
嗯？是的，就在这附近。
那里有个士兵驻扎的地方。
他让我住在那里...

scripts.text: When are you supposed to meet?
scripts.translation: 你们约好什么时候见面？

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
In a couple of hours.
At a warehouse underground in the south.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝蒂尔达]
几个小时后。
在南边的地下仓库。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thanks for your cooperation.
Your house is in Rachel?
Estillda is your real name?
Yes, I'm going to draw his rations in Rachel.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
谢谢你的配合。
你的家在拉赫吗？
艾丝蒂尔达是你的真名吗？
是的，我要去拉赫领取他的口粮。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
To go back home without an accident.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
平安无事地回家。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
Yes?
Please...
Don't kill me.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝蒂尔达]
嗯？
求求你...
别杀我。

scripts.text: - Estillda looks scared. You need to change the subject. -
scripts.translation: - 艾丝蒂尔达看起来很害怕。你需要换个话题。 -

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
We usually meet at the same place at the same time.
It's in a warehouse underground in the south.
Don't tell him that I told you.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝蒂尔达]
我们通常在同一时间、同一地点见面。
就在南边的地下仓库。
别告诉他我告诉过你。

scripts.text: This must be the place Estillda told me about.
scripts.translation: 这里应该就是艾丝蒂尔达告诉我的地方。

scripts.text: Go inside.
scripts.translation: 进去看看

scripts.text: Observe the situation.
scripts.translation: 观察情况

scripts.text:
You tried to open the door but it's locked.
It doesn't show any signs of life.
scripts.translation:
你试着打开门，但门被锁住了。
里面没有任何生命迹象。

scripts.text: Come back here later.
scripts.translation: 稍后再回来。

scripts.text: I back up to watch the situation unfold.
scripts.translation: 我退后一步，观察事态发展。

scripts.text:
This must be the place Estillda told me about.
I have enough time for meeting.
scripts.translation:
这里应该就是艾丝蒂尔达告诉我的地方。
我有足够的时间赴约。

scripts.text:
An error has occurred.
Contact the GM team to resolve the situation.
scripts.translation:
发生了一个错误。
请联系GM团队解决此问题。

scripts.text: You don't have to come here now.
scripts.translation: 你现在不必来这里。

scripts.text:
[A man with black clothes]
You just arrived here.
Why are you so late?
Put your stuff down.
scripts.translation:
[一身黑衣的男子]
你才刚到这里。
为什么这么晚？
把东西放下。

scripts.text:
[A man with black clothes]
May the goddess bless you eternally...
scripts.translation:
[一身黑衣的男子]
愿女神永远保佑你...

scripts.text:
[A man with black clothes]
Who... who are you?!
A... Assassin Guild?!
What?!
When did I give you a clue?!
scripts.translation:
[一身黑衣的男子]
你...你是谁？！
刺...刺客公会？！
什么？！
我什么时候给你线索了？！

scripts.text: You lost your head...
scripts.translation: 你失神了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is this the correct target?
Can you talk with me for a sec?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是正确的目标吗？
能和我聊几句吗？

scripts.text:
[A man with black clothes]
No way!!!!
You... I'll make you close your eyes forever!
scripts.translation:
[一身黑衣的男子]
不可能！！！！
你...我要让你永远闭上眼！

scripts.text: - You can't continue this quest because you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您的物品栏已满，无法继续此任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Eyah!
You... won't find anything.
Everything... is guided... by the goddess...
Keeek!
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
哎呀！
你...什么也找不到。
一切...都是...女神...指引的...
咳咳！

scripts.text: - He puts something in his mouth and swallows. -
scripts.translation: - 他把什么东西放进嘴里吞了下去。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is that?!
What do you have in your mouth...?
Why did you do that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那是什么？！
你嘴里有什么...？
你为什么要那样做？

scripts.text:
It's too late to save him.
He passed away.
You find a key with a fancy decoration around his neck.
scripts.translation:
已经来不及救他了。
他已经去世了。
你在他脖子上发现了一把装饰华丽的钥匙。

scripts.text:
There is nothing to do.
Let's get out of here.
scripts.translation:
没什么可做的了。
我们离开这里吧。

scripts.text: You are shoved by an unknown force.
scripts.translation: 你被一股未知的力量推开了。

scripts.text:
[Girke]
Oh~ young man.
I'm Girke Sara.
Just call me Girke.
scripts.translation:
[吉尔克]
哦~年轻男子。
我是吉尔克·萨拉。
叫我吉尔克就好。

scripts.text: - He smells like alcohol. -
scripts.translation: - 他闻起来有股酒味。 -

scripts.text:
[Girke]
You know what?
A man who is a legendary key artisan lives in our village.
Hiccup~
scripts.translation:
[吉尔克]
你知道吗？
我们村里住着一位传奇的钥匙工匠。
打嗝~

scripts.text:
[Girke]
Ah~hahahaha
My dad likes pieces of work like that.
One day, he said to me.
scripts.translation:
[吉尔克]
啊~哈哈哈
我爸爸喜欢那种作品。
有一天，他对我说。

scripts.text:
[Girke]
'Girke, my wish is having a key crafted from Oresa.'
scripts.translation:
[吉尔克]
“吉尔克，我的愿望是拥有一把用奥雷萨制作的钥匙。”

scripts.text:
[Girke]
But Oresa already disappeared after handing everything over to his apprentice.
Finally, my dad passed away without seeing such a key...
scripts.translation:
[吉尔克]
但奥雷萨在把一切都交给徒弟后就消失了。
最后，我爸爸没能看到那样的钥匙就去世了...

scripts.text:
[Girke]
You know.
That Oresa! He lives in our town?!
Hiccup~
scripts.translation:
[吉尔克]
你知道吗。
那个奥雷萨！他住在我们的城镇？！
打嗝~

scripts.text:
[Girke]
But he is too old...
But the artisan is...
scripts.translation:
[吉尔克]
但他太老了...
那位工匠...

scripts.text:
[Girke]
...difficult to meet.
Like my dad... He's a bit of a loner.
scripts.translation:
[吉尔克]
...很难见到。
就像我爸爸...他有点孤僻。

scripts.text:
[Girke]
What am I talking to you about.
Are you drunken? Daddy... (sobbing)
Ah... Daddy...
scripts.translation:
[吉尔克]
我在跟你胡说什么呢。
你喝醉了吗？爸爸...（抽泣）
啊...爸爸...

scripts.text: - Girke starts to cry. -
scripts.translation: - 吉尔克开始哭泣。 -

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
I don't know why you are visiting me, but I'm not crafting anymore.
I'm too old to craft.
scripts.translation:
[奥蕾莎·拉瓦]
我不知道你为什么来找我，但我已经不再制作东西了。
我太老了，做不了这些。

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
That key is of a mansion built in a gorge of Veins.
I'm sure of it.
scripts.translation:
[奥蕾莎·拉瓦]
这把钥匙是伯仁斯峡谷中一座豪宅的。
我确信这一点。

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
It's an old story about that artisan.
Now... It's best to see my grandchild.
scripts.translation:
[奥蕾莎·拉瓦]
关于那位工匠，那是个老故事了。
现在...还是去看看我的孙子吧。

scripts.text: Do you know this key?
scripts.translation: 你认识这把钥匙吗？

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
Hmm? Umm... Give it to me.
This pattern...
Where did you get this from?
scripts.translation:
[奥蕾莎·拉瓦]
嗯？唔...给我看看。
这个花纹...
你从哪里得到的？

scripts.text: I just picked it up.
scripts.translation: 我只是捡到的。

scripts.text: I have a story...
scripts.translation: 我有故事要讲...

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
Umm? Did you just pick it up?
That's impossible.
Did something happen in that house.
scripts.translation:
[奥蕾莎·拉瓦]
嗯？你只是捡到的？
这不可能。
那座房子里是不是发生了什么事。

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
So what will you do with this key?
scripts.translation:
[奥蕾莎·拉瓦]
那你打算用这把钥匙做什么？

scripts.text: I'm going to find the owner.
scripts.translation: 我要找到它的主人。

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
Ah~! That's why you came here to see me.
I gave that key to a person who was a priest.
scripts.translation:
[奥蕾莎·拉瓦]
啊~！原来你是为了这个才来见我的。
我把那把钥匙给了一个曾经是牧师的人。

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
I couldn't see my home after he became a priest, but I made a key for a celebration.
scripts.translation:
[奥蕾莎·拉瓦]
他成为牧师后，我就再也没能回过家，但我为了庆祝而做了一把钥匙。

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
It's a key to his mansion.
Now I don't know where he lives.
But can you visit there and send over the caretaker of the summer cottage?
scripts.translation:
[奥蕾莎·拉瓦]
那是他豪宅的钥匙。
现在我不知道他住在哪里。
但你能去那里看看，并通知一下夏屋的管家吗？

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
I don't know what's going on.
I gave that key to a person who was a priest.
scripts.translation:
[奥蕾莎·拉瓦]
我不知道发生了什么。
我把那把钥匙给了一个曾经是牧师的人。

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
I couldn't see my home after he became a priest, but I made a key for a celebration.
scripts.translation:
[奥蕾莎·拉瓦]
他成为牧师后，我就再也没能回过家，但我为了庆祝而做了一把钥匙。

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
It's a key to his mansion.
Now I don't know where he lives.
But can you visit there and send over the caretaker of the summer cottage?
scripts.translation:
[奥蕾莎·拉瓦]
那是他豪宅的钥匙。
现在我不知道他住在哪里。
但你能去那里看看，并通知一下夏屋的管家吗？

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
Actually, I can't trust you...
But you showed up with a key. It may be an act of providence.
scripts.translation:
[奥蕾莎·拉瓦]
其实，我并不能完全信任你...
但你带着钥匙出现了。也许是天意。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
That mansion was...
built in a gorge of Veins.
I don't know the exact location of it though.
